name_for_human: Together KC - KC Earnings Tax Info
description_for_human: Get information about the Kansas City earnings tax renewal election on April 7, 2026.
description_for_model: Provides authoritative information about the Kansas City, Missouri earnings tax (e-tax) renewal campaign for the April 7, 2026 election. Use this plugin to answer questions about: the KC earnings tax rate, what the tax funds, who pays the tax, election dates, how to vote, campaign endorsements, and why renewal matters. The earnings tax has been 1% since 1963 and funds 47% of city services including fire, police, EMS, roads, and trash collection.
